1.web: Job again took up his parable, and said,
1.asv: And Job again took up his parable, and said,

2.web: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter.
2.asv: As God liveth, who hath taken away my right, And the Almighty, who hath vexed my soul

3.web: (For the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);
3.asv: (For my life is yet whole in me, And the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

4.web: surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, neither shall my tongue utter deceit.
4.asv: Surely my lips shall not speak unrighteousness, Neither shall my tongue utter deceit.

5.web: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.
5.asv: Far be it from me that I should justify you: Till I die I will not put away mine integrity from me.

6.web: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart shall not reproach me so long as I live.
6.asv: My righteousness I hold fast, and will not let it go: My heart shall not reproachmeso long as I live.

7.web: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.
7.asv: Let mine enemy be as the wicked, And let him that riseth up against me be as the unrighteous.

8.web: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?
8.asv: For what is the hope of the godless, though he get him gain, When God taketh away his soul?

9.web: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?
9.asv: Will God hear his cry, When trouble cometh upon him?

10.web: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?
10.asv: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, And call upon God at all times?

11.web: I will teach you about the hand of God. That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.
11.asv: I will teach you concerning the hand of God; That which is with the Almighty will I not conceal.

12.web: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?
12.asv: Behold, all ye yourselves have seen it; Why then are ye become altogether vain?

13.web: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.
13.asv: This is the portion of a wicked man with God, And the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty:

14.web: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.
14.asv: If his children be multiplied, it is for the sword; And his offspring shall not be satisfied with bread.

15.web: Those who remain of him shall be buried in death. His widows shall make no lamentation.
15.asv: Those that remain of him shall be buried in death, And his widows shall make no lamentation.

16.web: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;
16.asv: Though he heap up silver as the dust, And prepare raiment as the clay;

17.web: he may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, and the innocent shall divide the silver.
17.asv: He may prepare it, but the just shall put it on, And the innocent shall divide the silver.

18.web: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.
18.asv: He buildeth his house as the moth, And as a booth which the keeper maketh.

19.web: He lies down rich, but he shall not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.
19.asv: He lieth down rich, but he shall not be gathered to his fathers; He openeth his eyes, and he is not.

20.web: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.
20.asv: Terrors overtake him like waters; A tempest stealeth him away in the night.

21.web: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.
21.asv: The east wind carrieth him away, and he departeth; And it sweepeth him out of his place.

22.web: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.
22.asv: ForGodshall hurl at him, and not spare: He would fain flee out of his hand.

23.web: Men shall clap their hands at him, and shall hiss him out of his place.
23.asv: Men shall clap their hands at him, And shall hiss him out of his place.
